cron-create-lead: Schedule a prompt to be enqueued at a future time.
cron-unreadable: The scheduled tasks file (.claude/scheduled_tasks.json) could not be read as a list of tasks
cron-session-only: Session-only (not written to disk, dies when Claude exits)
cron-one-shot-result: It will fire once then auto-delete.
cron-five-fields: Expected 5 fields: M H DoM Mon DoW.
cron-prompt-field: The prompt to enqueue at each fire time.
cron-field-lead: Standard 5-field cron expression in local time
cron-classifier: Scheduling a cron prompt requires classifier review.
cron-teammate: durable crons are not supported for teammates
cron-idle: Jobs only fire while the REPL is idle
cron-no-date: does not match any calendar date
send-classifier: Message to another agent requires classifier review.
send-recipient-max: recipient longer than any listed name
send-summary: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row
send-laundering: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action
send-main-queue: Message queued for the main conversation
send-notify-principal: notify_when_idle is only available from the main conversation
